objective: Validate an independent 1104 image sample end to end, then prevent broad traversable-surface candidates from being destroyed by an unsafe instance reclassification.

data_source.download_scope: one 640x512 PNG from each of directories 003 and 004; no raw MCAP and no recursive download

isolated_smoke.source_state_access: read-only model settings and label registry

observed_failure.sam_candidate_before_agent: a broad floor mask covering 45.6113 percent of the image
observed_failure.agent_operation: reclassify the entire floor candidate to ego because foreground host chassis was visible
observed_failure.post_audit: blind high-risk audit detected a class conflict but did not restore the original floor label
observed_failure.user_visible_effect: the correct broad floor candidate was displayed as ego

fix.policy: when a floor or slope candidate exceeds 35 percent of the frame, automatic reclassification to a registered instance class is rejected
fix.failure_route: preserve the original candidate and append global_surface_reclassify_requires_human_review
fix.small_candidate_behavior: small candidates remain eligible for supported reclassification

same_image_after_fix.note: The model is stochastic; this is a same-image observed run, not a latency distribution or accuracy benchmark.

regression.new_guard_unit_cases: large global surface rejected; small candidate reclassification preserved

limitations: The two 1104 images come from bevpending_data and have no human pixel truth, so this proves compatibility and one concrete semantic correction, not cross-dataset accuracy.
No slope is visible in these two samples; slope quality is not newly validated in this round.
The remaining end-to-end latency is dominated by VLM discovery and review, not image loading.
